mapper.select: select a.user_id userId, a.name userName, a.realname, a.type, a.mobile, a.open_id wxOpenId, c.role_id roleId, c.name AS roleName from b_user a JOIN r_user_role b ON b.user_id = a.user_id JOIN b_role c ON c.role_id = b.role_id where a.flag = 1 AND a.user_id = #{userId}

select b.`name` AS username, b.realname, b.open_id, a.user_id from r_user_role a LEFT JOIN b_user b ON b.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN r_user_tenant c ON c.user_id = b.user_id where b.flag = 1 and a.role_id = #{roleId} AND c.organization_id = #{organizationId}
select b.`name` AS username, b.realname, b.open_id, a.user_id from r_user_role a LEFT JOIN b_user b ON b.user_id = a.user_id where b.flag = 1 and a.role_id = #{roleId}

select a.open_id, a.type, a.user_id, a.`name`, a.mobile, a.remark, a.realname, a.address, a.company from b_user a LEFT JOIN r_user_tenant b ON b.user_id = a.user_id where a.flag != -1 AND b.organization_id = #{orgId}s
SELECT bo.app_id as appid FROM b_openid_share bos LEFT JOIN b_openid bo ON share_openid_id = bo.openid_id WHERE bos.flag = 1 AND bo.flag = 1 AND bos.user_id = #{uid}

SELECT count(b.user_id) FROM b_user b LEFT JOIN r_user_role r ON r.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN l_user_token l on l.user_id = b.user_id WHERE l.modify_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND r.role_id = 5
